skill.summary: A complete Chinese novel writing studio with 15 specialized AI agents covering the full creative workflow

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Novel Studio: an end-to-end Chinese novel writing system.
- Includes 15 specialized agents for every creative phase: market analysis, planning, writing, editing, compliance, and more.
- Supports major genres with dedicated specialists (mystery, romance, sci-fi, xianxia).
- Provides structured workflows for writing, planning, editing, and continuity management.
- Clear setup and project file guidelines for seamless novel creation.
